subject: Stellara — follow-up & mutual action plan draft
messages:
From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
To: Elena Soto <elena.soto@stellara.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 13 Aug 2028 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up: Stellara inference priorities & next steps

Hi Elena —

Thanks again for taking time today. Quick recap from our end so we’re aligned and can convert this into a short mutual action plan. I focused the notes on the concrete pain points, goals, and suggested next steps so your team can easily forward to Raj and Maria.

Pain points you called out
- Latency spikes for interactive assistance (especially 99th pct during peak hours) causing poor CSAT.
- Cost unpredictability on burst traffic for chat and embeddings workloads.
- Compliance: need for audit logs and longer retention for some regulated datasets.

Goals
- Pilot: verify interactive 99th percentile < 250ms for typical sessions, and embedding throughput > 1k reqs/min for batch jobs.
- Security: SOC 2 evidence and network/data flow mapping to show no PHI leaves the VPC.
- Decision: procurement-ready recommendation and executive sign-off by early November.

Proposed immediate next steps (draft MPA items)
1) Technical trial (2–4 weeks): Redwood hosted trial with a pinned model + telemetry capture — target start: week of 8/28 — owner: Connor (Redwood) / Elena (Stellara).
2) Security review: we’ll share SOC2 + data-flow and you’ll return the security questionnaire — due 9/8 — owner: Monica (Redwood) / Maria (Stellara).
3) Cost model & sizing: Redwood to provide committed pricing options for Dedicated and Private (incl. burst allowance) — due 9/1 — owner: Aditya (Redwood).
4) Executive review & procurement: internal Stellara review — target decision window: 11/1–11/10 — owner: Raj (Stellara).

Attachments: I’m attaching a short security request checklist and a draft MPA workbook for milestones/owners.

If that looks right I’ll formalize the MPA and drop a calendar invite for a kickoff (30–45m) the week of 8/28. Any tweaks to owners or dates, let me know.

Quick ask: who on your side should be the official procurement contact (for pricing/PO routing)?

Thanks —
Connor O'Brien
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
connor.obrien@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0192

Attachments: [Stellara-Security-Request.pdf (application/pdf) — 4 pages], [Stellara-MPA-Draft.xlsx (spreadsheet) — 2 sheets]
From: Elena Soto <elena.soto@stellara.com>

Date: Tue, 14 Aug 2028 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up: Stellara inference priorities & next steps

Connor —

Appreciate the concise recap. This aligns with what I’ll bring to the internal kickoff. Quick clarifications / confirmations from our side:

Stakeholders (please include these in the MPA):
- Raj Patel (CTO) — final procurement sign-off
- Maria Gomez (Head of Security & Compliance) — SOC2 & questionnaire lead
- Elena Soto (Head of ML) — pilot owner / technical champion

Priority order: 1) Latency stability for interactive assistant, 2) Embedding batch throughput and cost predictability, 3) Audit logs / retention and encryption proof points.

Timing: the week of 8/28 for a short technical kickoff works. Procurement target is a bit later on our calendar — aiming for decision between 11/6 and 11/10 to coincide with budget review.

Deliverables we’ll need from Redwood to proceed:
- Current SOC 2 report (or redacted summary) + any SOC2-authorized subprocessor list
- A simple data flow diagram showing where model inputs/outputs, logs, and customer data will reside during the pilot
- Initial committed-cost scenarios for Dedicated and Private deployments (monthly + expected token/embedding budgets)

I’ll route the security questionnaire to Maria and get you back an estimated response date by Friday. Our procurement contact will be Raj for the initial thread — I’ll cc him on the kickoff once we have the calendar.

Thanks — looking forward to the kickoff.

Monica / Aditya — forwarding Elena's note and the initial MPA draft. TL;DR: Raj (CTO) and Maria (Head of Security) will be the procurement/security owners. They want SOC2 and a data-flow diagram + committed pricing scenarios.

Action items I need from you both:
- Monica: please attach the latest SOC2 summary and the short answers to the security checklist (I’ve attached their requested security-request PDF). Also confirm whether we can provide a redacted subprocessor list by EOD 8/17.
- Aditya: can you build two committed-pricing scenarios (Dedicated monthly commit + Private on-prem estimate) with expected token/embedding budgets for a 3-month pilot? Need this by 9/1 per Elena. Include burst allowance pricing and an explicit SLA note for 99th pct latency targets.

I’ll draft the formal MPA once we have those docs and will schedule the 8/28 kickoff — please hold 8/28 10:00–10:45 PT for the initial call (invite pending).

Thanks —
Connor

Elena / Raj / Maria —

Thanks for confirming owners and timing. Per our internal prep we pulled together a short Mutual Action Plan (MPA) summary below and attached the workbook with milestones. This is the version we’ll iterate on in the kickoff.

Mutual Action Plan — summary (owners + dates)
1) Kickoff & trial setup (30–45m) — target: 2028-08-28 — owners: Connor (Redwood) / Elena (Stellara). Calendar invite sent.
2) Security packet delivered (SOC2 + redacted subprocessor list + short answers) — due: 2028-08-17 — owner: Monica (Redwood).
3) Data flow diagram & pilot integration notes (network egress, logging, retention) — due: 2028-08-21 — owner: Connor (Redwood) to coordinate with your infra lead.
4) Committed pricing scenarios (Dedicated monthly commit, Private on-prem estimate, burst allowance) — due: 2028-09-01 — owner: Aditya (Redwood).
5) Pilot (2–4 weeks technical validation) — window: 2028-09-04 to 2028-09-25 — owners: Connor (Redwood) / Elena (Stellara). Goals: 99th pct latency < 250ms, embedding batch throughput >= 1k reqs/min, telemetry enabled.
6) Exec review & procurement decision — target window: 2028-11-06 to 2028-11-10 — owner: Raj (Stellara).

Decision criteria:
- Pilot meets latency and throughput goals,
- Security questionnaire & SOC2 acceptable to Maria,
- Committed pricing falls within Stellara budget range (Aditya to provide 2 options).

Attachments included:
- Stellara-Security-Request.pdf — security checklist for completion
- Stellara-MPA-Draft.xlsx — worksheet with milestones, owner columns and a simple RACI

Next steps for you:
- Maria / Elena: confirm the kickoff attendee list and the procurement contact (Raj confirmed; please add anyone else who needs calendar visibility).
- Maria: if the SOC2 turnaround is tight, tell us which specific control areas matter most and we’ll prioritize clarifications.

I’ve linked the HubSpot opportunity and a Drive folder where the MPA will live: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/company/98765 | https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cStellaraPilot

If that looks right I’ll mark the MPA as draft in the workbook and we’ll pick it up in the kickoff.

Thanks everyone —
Connor O'Brien
